reviews.title: Solid App Made it Right for Legacy Cusotmers
reviews.text:
UPDATE

⭐ 5 Stars

Updating my review for Daily Workouts - Home Fitness — they made things right.

After concerns about the switch to a subscription model, they restored access for legacy users who had already paid. That shows they listen to their customers and stand behind what they sold.

I appreciate the fix and the integrity. The app is back to being a solid, reliable workout tool. Highly recommend.

⭐ 1 Star

I paid for Daily Workouts - Home Fitness expecting to own the app, but now they’ve switched to a subscription model and want me to pay again for “lifetime” access. That’s not right.

This feels like a bait-and-switch. Customers who already paid shouldn’t be forced into a subscription just to keep using what they already bought.

Because of this, the app is junk to me now and completely dead. I would not recommend it to anyone who’s has purchased this app I will make my own app

reviews.title: Very few free features
reviews.text:
I rarely leave app reviews. 

I've been using Daily Workouts for 6 years.
It used to have free workouts, in addition to paid ones. 
I could cover all basic muscle groups with the free workouts. 

It has changed over the years, putting more and more workouts behind a paywall. 
Most workouts are simply not free now. 

I do not recommend this app. I am looking for a new workout app.
